creator: OpenAI Codex for Tien Nghich 2D
rights: Original note score, voice synthesis and arrangement created for the project. All audible input is generated from the supplied score and oscillator/noise patch. No recordings, samples or soundfont.
render: From the checkout root, run python -B assets/audio/bgm_hengyue/render.py <output.wav> with CPython 3.14.0 and NumPy 2.5.5. The output parent directory must exist.
patch: PCG64 seed 7829. Damped plucked harmonics alternate stereo position and pick point. Seeded air and a three-partial oscillator voice the bamboo phrases. Notes, releases and short cross-channel reflections wrap modulo the loop. Fixed mix gains, nearest-even PCM16 quantization without dither.
loop_units: sample frames per channel, end exclusive
onset_tail: The preceding bar's flute pickup and its reflections are already sounding at frame zero and continue across the final frame.

verification.rebuild: Two independent render processes wrote to separate empty directories. Both WAV hashes matched the master.
